from fractions import Fraction as Q
from pathlib import Path
import json
values=[Q(i,3) for i in range(-12,13)]
tested=violations=0
for a in values:
 assert a*a/2 <= a*a
 tested+=1
for b in values:
 if b:
  assert 2*b*b>b*b
  violations+=1
complements=0
for n in range(2,17):
 # Every tested basis vector has eigenvalue 9/10; its orthogonal complement
 # contains a vector of eigenvalue 2. Increasing finite test size cannot help.
 for j in range(n-1):
  v=[Q(int(i==j)) for i in range(n)]
  energy=sum(Q(9,10)*x*x for x in v[:-1])+2*v[-1]**2
  assert energy<=sum(x*x for x in v)
  complements+=1
 v=[Q(0)]*(n-1)+[Q(1)]
 assert sum(Q(9,10)*x*x for x in v[:-1])+2*v[-1]**2>sum(x*x for x in v)
 complements+=1
result=dict(passed=True,tested_sector_cases=tested,untested_sector_violations=violations,complement_basis_cases=complements,arithmetic='Python fractions.Fraction; exact rational arithmetic')
Path('.lake/stardust-1294-exact-tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(result)
